title: Largest 3-Same-Digit Number in String
summary: Given a string num representing a large integer, find the largest substring of length 3 that consists of the same digit.
statement: Given a string num representing a large integer, find the largest substring of length 3 that consists of the same digit. Return this digit as a string, or an empty string if no such substring exists.
constraints: Inspect every contiguous substring of length three.
A candidate is valid only when all three characters are the same digit.
Return the largest valid three-character string, preserving 000, or an empty string if none exists.
hints: A chained equality identifies windows containing one repeated digit.
For each valid piece, update the lexicographically largest string.
All valid results have equal length, so string order matches digit value, and exhaustive windows ensure none is missed.
editorial: All valid results have equal length, so string order matches digit value, and exhaustive windows ensure none is missed.

tests.explanation: The valid groups are 777 and 333, so 777 is larger.
The only valid group is 000, which must be returned with all three zeros.
